content: Git-backed CMS architecture: content stored as flat files (markdown/JSON/YAML) in git repos, giving free versioning/audit/history/CI-CD integration/rollback; database-backed CMS struggles with versioning file-based relations; git is not ideal for large binary assets (use LFS or external object storage/CDN for media); git repos with thousands of large files become unwieldy; real-time collaborative editing is weaker than DB-backed CMS.
